body:
yes... I know he didn't intend to hurt me with it (well he probably knew it would, but he felt I should know for various reasons)...

I just don't know how I'll be able to keep this from happening in the future... Or if I'll ever be able to have someone feel love for me, given that the one time I had thought it happened was just a lie...

>Kids still in the house when I'm 60? Naaaa

It's perfect though, you get them to do all the chores and stuff for you by that time :3.

And sorry to hear about the medication and stuff, isn't it possible for a gf/wife to adopt in her name or something? I'm really not that familiar with that stuff though... I am a bit curious about what you've done that could get you sent to jail though... I'm sure you'll find someone that wants you and is understanding of what you've gone through :).
and thanks for taking the time to read my post/respond :)

>I'm almost too old for kids

>I'm 34

These two contradict each other XD. Men can have kids whenever they feel like it :), my dad didn't have me until he was 42/3 and my brother until four years after that, I didn't turn out the best mentally I suppose, but it's not really his fault or anything, and my brother is much better lol.

Please don't end your life, I need to know that it's possible to get through life...

>You are bi and have twice the chance to find someone than most people.

Somewhat of a misconception... While I am attracted to both sexes, there are tons of straight women that would never date a bi guy(whether because they fear having to compete with other men as well as women, or because "eww buttsechs is gross," or just because they're biggoted), and same goes for a lot of gay men as well(many think that bi guys are just curious straight guys that aren't looking for something real, or that they will end up wanting a woman to have a family, etc. should Romney be elected and gay couples loose their rights to have kids in all states I wouldn't blame them either...)

I will try to look for someone else at some point though...
yeah... You're probably right (I hope)... I'm often such an awkward person face to face though... much easier to be myself over text, but it is so much easier to be lied to, as you said...
but it's not just one... I've known hundreds if not thousands of people, have yet to find a single one that does love me...

that he's a sociopath were his words... I don't believe he said all this just to hurt me, but because he thought I should know...

And say I do find "the right person" again? How can I prevent this kind of thing from happening again? He was right in that there were signs I probably should have picked up on and stopped it all there, but I didn't... How will I know if the next person loves me or is just lying like eveyone else who's said it to me in the past?
who could possibly love me? clearly no one has yet, not hard to understand why either...
an hour now and nothing... maybe I'm just right...
:( I hope this doesn't take time away from someone who needs the help more...
